Nadia: Heads-up: spotted several invoices in the A/B pricing pilot where unit-of-measure changed from 'request' to 'token' during the rollout, causing customers to be billed ~3x higher. Example INV-9401 billed $900 vs expected ~$300.
Cole: Yikes. Which manifest introduced the change? Did the schema validator catch it?
Nadia: The manifest `ab-experiment-v2.csv` included a column unit=token for a handful of rows. We expected unit=request. Validator allowed it because unit is optional for legacy rows.
Marta: Which cohort (A/B)? Impacting cohort-A (control should have stayed request). How many customers? Quick scan shows 7 invoices affected over last 24h.
Ravi: Policy: credits <= $500 per invoice ops can approve; total exposure > $2k requires controller sign-off. Total exposure ~ $1,950, so ops can proceed.
Cole: Proposed action: 1) Re-upload corrected manifest with unit=request; 2) Dry-run reconcile for the 7 invoices; 3) Create credits per invoice for the delta; 4) Add schema validator rule to require unit for any price rows in experiments.
Nadia: Commands I plan to run (dry-run first):
```
billing-cli prices upload --manifest gs://redwood-prod/manifests/ab-experiment-v2-fixed.csv --dry-run
billing-cli invoices reconcile --invoice INV-9401 --dry-run
billing-cli credits create --invoice INV-9401 --amount 600 --reason "unit-of-measure backfill" --dry-run
```
Marta: Hold 45m for customer comms and to confirm amounts. I'll approve credits after we verify amounts with reconciliation.
FinanceBot: INV-9401 generated 2026-04-10 11:07 UTC. Status: paid. Note: reconcile dry-run completed may not modify ledger.
Ravi: Ok to proceed after dry-run and customer note. @Marta please ping when ready and we'll apply credits. Also add playbook item: "force unit column present for experiment rows".
Nadia: Will run dry-run now and post results. I'll draft customer message explaining temporary manifest mistake and one-time credit.
Cole: After credits, monitor next 2 billing cycles for any residual unit mismatches. Set alert to scan experiment cohorts hourly for unit changes.
Marta: Will do. Creating follow-up ticket FIN-2501 and assigning ownership.
